change: Trim trailing padding only for semantic AMBER identifier assertions; keep raw cross-architecture comparisons exact
reason: AMBER identifiers are fixed-width fields. Both the original bundled Intel library and candidate return identical padded names, types, and residue names.
evidence: ARM water probe preserves fixed-width names. Earlier Intel comparison claim was premature: the full Intel probe rejected ABI20 before reading; this is corrected by the explicit reference-only ABI20 probe, with raw fields still compared exactly.
confirmation: Corrected original Intel ABI20 probe subsequently passed water.parm7 and water-missing.parm7; all raw reader fields match ARM exactly.

change: Require full raw line counts before excluding variable volume lines; record the active harness hash in each test report
reason: Test-code review found that excluding volume lines before counting could miss a deleted volume record. Added a failing-then-passing regression test before scientific reference comparisons.

change: Intel reference probe expects bundled ABI20; ARM probe still strictly requires ABI18. Compare all reader data exactly, excluding the separately asserted ABI metadata.
reason: Diagnostic registration reports original Intel archive parm7 ABI20. fpocket headers and pinned molfile source headers have identical molfile layouts; only vmdplugin ABI constant differs. Do not upgrade candidate ABI.

change: ARM build adds -ffp-contract=off to fpocket C compilation; O2, hardening, Qhull recipe, ABI18, algorithm source and reference comparisons remain unchanged.
reason: Original ARM build changes deterministic surface areas, scores and ranking. Recompiling only asa.c without contraction did not resolve it; recompiling all fpocket C objects without contraction reproduces the complete 1UYD reference exactly (except previously excluded volumes).
evidence: diagnostic-no-fma and diagnostic-no-fma-all directories retain builds and outputs; full clean builds and full validation required next.

reason: Test review tightened environment identity and actual-user permissions beyond checking a sha256 prefix; both clean builds subsequently passed these checks under Scion uid/gid1000.
